keyPoints.en: Collective: a herd of cows, a bunch of grapes, a team of players
keyPoints.hi: समूहवाचक: a herd of cows, a bunch of grapes, a team of players

keyPoints.en: Abstract: love, fear, kindness, childhood (cannot be touched)
keyPoints.hi: भाववाचक: love, fear, kindness, childhood (छू नहीं सकते)

steps.en: An army is a group of soldiers.

problem.en: Find the abstract noun: "The child was full of happiness."
problem.hi: भाववाचक संज्ञा ढूँढो: "The child was full of happiness."

steps.en: child can be seen; happiness is a feeling.
steps.hi: child दिखता है; happiness एक भावना है।

question.en: Is "bravery" a common or an abstract noun?

intro.en: Nouns are of different kinds: proper (Ravi, Delhi), common (boy, city), collective (a group: a flock of birds), material (things made from: gold, wood) and abstract (feelings and ideas: joy, honesty).
intro.hi: संज्ञा कई तरह की होती है: proper (Ravi, Delhi), common (boy, city), collective (समूह: a flock of birds), material (पदार्थ: gold, wood) और abstract (भाव और विचार: joy, honesty)।
